column1: # Version codes this project has already spent, oldest first.
# "Spent" means the code has been attached to a release artifact that left this repository --
# uploaded to Play, or handed to a tester. Google Play refuses a second upload carrying a version
# code it has already seen; this file is the same rule, enforced by `verifyReleaseVersion` before
# `bundleRelease` produces anything rather than by the Play Console after a tag has been pushed.
# Tab-separated: version code, version name, date the code was spent, and what spent it.
# Append one line per release, in the same commit that moves versionCode/versionName in
# app/build.gradle.kts. Never edit or remove a line: a spent code stays spent forever.
# (MAJOR * 10000 + MINOR * 100 + PATCH) and for all four rules this file feeds.

column4: pre-release development builds, before release engineering existed; never uploaded anywhere
